frase_gancho.texto: A living building that is slowly sinking and that holds five centuries of art.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You enter the Cathedral. You will see the central nave, the choir with its organs, the Altar of Forgiveness and the Altar of the Kings, the side chapels, the Chapel of San Felipe de Jesús with the remains of Iturbide, the sacristy with the crypt and, finally, the floor and the sinking that has damaged the building. There are eight stops. The order of the chapels may vary depending on works in progress and on the access restrictions of the day.
